route_source: Shortest connected modeled walk among eligible mapped entrances and retained estimated building access points, using the frozen November 1 NC State GIS network plus November 10 pedestrian supplements. The Greek-area supplement uses public OpenStreetMap footways, pedestrian-designated cycleways and steps; private/no-foot ways and building-interior shortcuts are excluded. Source endpoints are aligned to existing paths by at most 1.5 m, without joining arbitrary geometric crossings. Separately documented parking aisles and a shared access-drive crossing of Varsity Drive are included, with four explicitly estimated rear building-edge options, not verified doors. Existing front access remains eligible. The Bilyeu–Pullen supplement includes a reviewed bridge and a 24.1 m approximate marked-crossing approach. Public arterial road centerlines are not added. Door permissions, crossing safety, accessibility and October-specific conditions are not certified.
